cluster_frozen_vs_scalar_frozen.scope_note: the bootstrap covers only the submetrics that are literally means over samples (0.5875 of the 1.0 module weight). Pooled and per-protein-mean submetrics are not sample means, so resampling samples does not yield a valid bootstrap distribution for them and they are excluded rather than approximated. The CI is therefore a CI on that component of the margin, not on the full total.

method: paired non-parametric bootstrap over validation samples: both candidates are scored on the same resampled sample sets, so the shared cohort sampling noise cancels and the CI reflects only their disagreement
